confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Sri Lankan hill-country tourist pricing, not live listings. Restaurant and café anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by season, guesthouse grade and tax/service-charge treatment. Cocktail and wine were set relative to beer because direct knowledge is weaker; Sri Lankan wine is import-taxed and priced high. The FX observation came from search-result summaries of RBA data and was not verified by reading the RBA page directly, so confirm it against the source URL before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on the Sri Lankan hill-country tourist circuit, using Kandy and Ella as reference points. Adjusted for Nuwara Eliya's cooler highland climate and its guesthouse-heavy accommodation market. July falls in the southwest monsoon, outside the April peak season, so no peak-season uplift is applied.
